# The induction audit asks the old question

The annual form still asks how many volunteers attended compliance training. We can report the supported practice sessions and explain the change. Renaming the work did not end it. [[Volunteer handbook]] should keep a small terminology crosswalk so an administrative mismatch does not make a year of teaching look absent.
